subject: Procurement path & vendor packet for Redwood trial
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement path & vendor packet for Redwood trial

Hi Sara — great demo today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + ask on next steps for procurement so we can get you onto trial capacity this month.

Key points from the call
- Trial: 3-week proof-of-concept (up to 250k tokens / month).
- Data: no customer data will be stored outside of the trial instance; private VPC option available if needed.
- Success criteria: latency under 200ms p95, integration of embedding endpoint for search demo.

Procurement questions (so procurement can route the request internally)
1) Preferred purchasing path: PO (net terms) vs P-Card? If PO, do you need vendor W-9 + insurance cert up front?
2) Marketplace interest: would you prefer a marketplace purchase (AWS/GCP) or direct invoicing?
3) Banking/payment details: if direct invoice, does AP require ACH details now or after vendor setup?
4) Timeline: target start week of 6/21 — is that realistic once paperwork is submitted?

I've attached our vendor packet (redwood-vendor-packet.pdf) which includes: W-9, standard commercial terms, insurance summary, and instructions for our vendor portal if you want to skip the PO route.

Next steps I suggest:
- You loop in procurement (procurement@lumenhealth.com) with their preferred intake form filled or reply with the required documents.
- If PO route: confirm billing contact and internal code (S2P vendor code / requisition owner).
- If marketplace: let me know preferred cloud and I’ll route options/pricing.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call with your procurement lead to walk through the packet — available Mon/Tue mornings.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachment: redwood-vendor-packet.pdf (W-9, terms summary, insurance stub)

Thanks Connor — good demo. Looping in our procurement team (cc'd) so they see the packet. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- LumenHealth is a US entity, so procurement will need a completed W-9 and vendor legal name exactly as it appears on tax forms. Can you confirm the payee name you use for invoice?
- We prefer PO + Net-30 for new vendors. That said, if you support marketplace billing we occasionally use that path for shorter proofs.
- AP asks for bank routing/ACH only after vendor setup, but they do want an estimated monthly spend to set thresholds — can you share the expected spend range for the 3-week trial?

Procurement next steps (from procurement team)
- Please complete our intake form (attached) and return with W-9.
- If Redwood requires specific contract language (data processing, security), include a marked copy so procurement legal can triage.

Procurement note attachment: lumen-procurement-intake.xlsx

—Sara
Sara Lin
Senior Product Manager, Search
LumenHealth

1) Payee name for tax forms: "Redwood Inference, Inc." — W-9 attached (see redwood-vendor-packet.pdf).
2) Estimated trial spend: for the config we discussed (embedding + chat, light volume) expect $700–1,200 for the 3-week POC. If you scale during the trial it could go up to $2,500.
3) Marketplace: we are listed on AWS Marketplace as "Redwood Inference — Hosted API" (optional). If procurement prefers the marketplace route we can provide a quick comparison doc and an AM contact.

If procurement prefers PO path: please send the intake form back with PO number and billing contact. If they'd like, Marissa (cc) can run the intake for you and we can complete any DocuSign steps.

Links: vendor packet (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1RedwoodVendorPacket) and DocuSign payment terms (https://app.docusign.com/recipient/1234abcd).

Connor / Marissa — procurement here. We reviewed the packet; LumenHealth will proceed via PO + Net-30 for onboarding new vendors. A couple items we need to complete vendor setup:

- Completed intake form (we attached lumen-procurement-intake.xlsx) — please return with your W-9 (we have it from your packet, but please re-submit on your letterhead if possible).
- Vendor insurance certificate (general liability; the summary in the packet is fine; we need the actual cert).

- Please confirm vendor tax ID (EIN) and the legal remit name exactly as it should appear on the PO.

Once we receive the intake form + W-9 on letterhead + insurance cert we will create the vendor record and issue a PO (target 3 business days after complete docs). Send documents to procurement@lumenhealth.com.
